methods.label: Check standard notation conventions
methods.explanation: When multiplying a number and a letter, omit the multiplication sign and write the number before the letter, so \(a\times4\) should be written as \(4a\). A coefficient of 1 is omitted, so \(1a\) should be written as \(a\). Division should be written as a fraction, \(a/b\).
methods.levelReason: All three conventions belong to Grade 7 standard notation for algebraic expressions.
